data.name: SessionOnly
data.value: This session only. Searches are kept in memory and cleared when the app closes.

data.name: SearchPlaceholder
data.value: SteamID64, steamcommunity.com URL, or vanity slug

data.name: SearchHint
data.value: Vanity slugs are profile URL identifiers. Display names are not unique and cannot be resolved globally.

data.name: AvailableData
data.value: Facts from the data Steam makes available.

data.name: StartTitle
data.value: A profile is the starting point.

data.name: StartMessage
data.value: Enter a SteamID64, a profile URL, or a vanity slug above. You can explore different profiles without signing in to Steam.

data.name: SetupTitle
data.value: Connect your Steam Web API key

data.name: SetupMessage
data.value: Create a local .env beside PADO.GamePulse.sln when running from source, or beside GamePulse.Desktop.exe for the portable/installed app. Set GAMEPULSE_STEAM_API_KEY to your own key and restart the app. An existing environment variable takes priority. Never share your .env.

data.name: PrivacyNote
data.value: No Steam login. No database. Private data stays private.

data.name: BanNote
data.value: These are source facts, not a trust score. N/A means the information is unavailable.

data.name: ScopeMessage
data.value: Explore profiles, libraries, friends, achievements and public inventories. Compare any two profiles, discover shared games, inspect Library Pulse and export filtered tables to CSV. Source availability and privacy determine which facts Steam exposes.

data.name: CompareRoadmap
data.value: Compare · any two profiles & mutual games

data.name: AboutMessage
data.value: An independent Steam profile explorer. No Steam sign-in or database is required. Your optional .env is private local plaintext. Release packages contain no API key; the source archive includes an empty .env.example.

data.name: ShortcutHint
data.value: Ctrl+L Profile · Ctrl+F Page filter · Enter Explore · Esc Cancel

data.name: SearchingMessage
data.value: Summary appears first. Optional details load independently.

data.name: ReadyMessage
data.value: Missing fields remain N/A. Refresh bypasses the data cache.

data.name: CancelledMessage
data.value: Already received data remains visible. Start another search or refresh to continue.

data.name: InvalidInput
data.value: Enter a valid SteamID64, Steam profile URL or vanity slug. Display names are not unique. Use the identifier in the profile URL.

data.name: MissingKey
data.value: A Steam API key is required. Add GAMEPULSE_STEAM_API_KEY to your local .env, or set the environment variable, then restart the app.

data.name: Private
data.value: Steam did not allow access to this information.

data.name: NotFound
data.value: No matching profile was returned. Check the SteamID64 or vanity URL.

data.name: RateLimited
data.value: Steam is rate limiting requests. Please try again later.

data.name: Unavailable
data.value: This information is unavailable from Steam.

data.name: Empty
data.value: Steam returned no information for this request.

data.name: Failed

data.name: ExternalFailed

data.name: ClipboardFailed
